hyperedges.label: Local hot-reload dev stack (compose.sh + docker-compose.yml + docker-compose.local.yml)
NestJS application bootstrap (main.ts + AppModule + AppController + AppService)
Shared pagination DTOs (PaginatedResponseDto wraps PaginationMetadataDto)
Pagination Flow: DTO + Metadata + CoreRepository
Auth System: AuthGuard + RolesGuard + NoAuth decorator
Config Validation: All configs use Joi + registerAs pattern
All GST specialist clients extend BaseGstClient and are exported by GstModule
FormService dispatches to Order/Product/Customer/SupplierService via entityDataMap for dropdown options
ProductsController, ProductService, and ProductRepository form the product CRUD stack
LocationModule wires Controller -> Service -> Repository with Mongoose schemas
ShopModule wires Controller -> Service -> Repository for shop CRUD and team management
GST readiness metadata is seeded dormant across Country, State, City schemas and GstDetailsDto
User auth flow: Controller → Service → Repository → JWT
Supplier CRUD stack: Controller → Service → Repository + CodeService
Shop, GstDetails, and SupplierLink form the core tenant data model
Inventory CRUD flow: Controller → Service → Repository
SupplierLink composes SupplierStats subdoc and uses SupplierStatus enum
Media upload flow: Controller → Service → MetadataRepository
Order creation pipeline: CreateOrderDto assembles OrderItemDto + BillingDetailsDto + PaymentDetailsDto
Invoice numbering: InvoiceCounter + InvoiceCounterRepository + InvoiceNumberService implement per-shop per-FY atomic counter
GST tax chain: TaxType enum drives TaxDetailDto drives BillingDetailsDto taxes breakdown
CustomerModule wires Service, Repository, CodeService, Controller
Customer code auto-generation: CodeService -> CounterRepository -> CustomerCounter schema
GST classification: GstRegistrationType enum + GSTIN field + GSTR-1 classification rationale
seed.js writes to shops, users, products, inventories, customers, customercounters, suppliercounters collections
Location collections (countries, states, cities) collectively power GST place-of-supply automation
InvoiceCounter, CustomerCounter, SupplierCounter all use atomic findOneAndUpdate upsert pattern
Order billing data flows from pricing util through form state to submission hooks
Order domain interfaces compose to form complete order data model
GST inter/intra-state determination used across form, customer card, and item list
Shop member management: tab orchestrates invite, update-role, remove hooks
Shop CRUD hooks: add, update, delete operate on Shop entity
ShopSwitcher + ShopCard use useRecentShops for shop switch tracking
Product CRUD hooks collectively manage product data via TanStack Query and ProductApi
SidebarImageUpload, ProductFeaturedImages, and SidebarViewImages form the product image management pipeline
DashboardCard01-03 share identical static LineChart01 structure with store-level sales data
FindSupplierPanel UI composition stack
Dashboard Shell (Header + Sidebar + ShopSelect)
Supplier CRUD TanStack Query hooks
Customer CRUD mutation hooks sharing cache invalidation pattern
Supplier CRUD mutation hooks sharing cache invalidation pattern
CustomerSelectModal composes SearchableListCustomer + CustomerForm + usePutCustomer
All chart components consume ThemeProvider and ChartjsConfig for dark/light mode rendering
Customer hooks use activeShop from ShopContext to scope all API queries
Core context providers forming the global state layer: Auth, Theme, Alert, Shop
Dropdown UI Components sharing Transition animation and click-outside pattern
GST-related enums forming Indian tax compliance domain
Customer-domain enums collectively describing customer entity
react-hook-form Controlled Field Components
Components using Transition for animated overlays
Uncontrolled primitive input components
All domain API classes route through shared apiClient with JWT auth
Paginated list APIs share Pagination interface pattern
Auth context interfaces consumed by AuthApi and useAuth hook
Order module pages (all/add/edit/print)
Shop module pages (all/add/edit/detail/setup)
Supplier module pages (all/add/edit/detail)
Customer CRUD UI flow: add -> list -> detail pages
CustomerDetailPage tabs: OverviewTab and OrdersTab compose detail view
Frontend based on Mosaic Lite Tailwind template (index.html, README, CHANGELOG)

nodes.label: Signup Page Illustration — undraw 'remotely' scene featuring a flat-style vector illustration (artist: Katerina Limpitsouni, undraw.co). The composition includes: a central human figure (person with dark hair) seated at a laptop/desktop computer setup, wearing a purple/indigo outfit, representing a remote worker or user signing up. Background elements include decorative plant motifs (stylised leafy branches in purple/indigo #6c63ff and grey), multiple floating UI card/list components with checklist rows (dark #3f3d56 panels), a large bookshelf or storage rack unit on the right side, and abstract horizontal lines evoking a workspace or office environment. Colour palette: indigo/violet (#6c63ff), near-black (#3f3d56, #2f2e41), light grey (#e6e6e6, #ccc), white, and skin-tone peach (#ffb8b8). Style is the characteristic undraw flat illustration style with no outlines, bold fills, and simplified geometric shapes. Overall mood conveys digital onboarding, account creation, or remote productivity.

nodes.label: Login Screen Illustration (login1.svg) — A flat-style vector illustration from unDraw (artist: Katerina Limpitsouni) depicting a stylized architectural or panel layout resembling a login interface backdrop. The composition features a large rounded-rectangle structure in light gray (#f2f2f2) and medium gray (#ccc) representing a building or card form, with a white inner panel suggesting a login card. Grid lines in gray divide the interior into columns and rows. A small purple circle (#6c63ff) marks a focal point (avatar/profile indicator). Two human figures in purple shirts and dark trousers stand beside the structure, each with peach/skin-toned arms and faces, suggesting users or administrators interacting with the system. Decorative organic tree/bush shapes in light gray flank the sides. A dark baseline ground line anchors the scene. The overall palette is soft: white, light gray, medium gray, purple (#6c63ff), dark near-black (#2f2e41), and peach (#ffb8b8). Style is minimal, modern, and illustration-first — typical of unDraw open-source SVG assets used in SaaS login screens.
nodes.author: Katerina Limpitsouni

nodes.label: Login Screen Illustration Variant 2 — A flat-style vector illustration (from unDraw by Katerina Limpitsouni) depicting a login/authentication scene. Features a central standing human figure with dark hair rendered in a purple/indigo (#6c63ff) and dark charcoal (#3f3d56) color palette against a light grey (#f2f2f2) circular backdrop. The figure interacts with floating UI elements: an envelope/email card with a purple inbox tray, a password/security card panel, and a mobile device showing a lock-screen interface. Decorative tree/plant shapes with organic leaf forms in grey tones flank the composition. Ground-level floor indicators and subtle shadow planes add depth. The overall style is minimal, geometric, and modern — consistent with the unDraw open-source illustration library aesthetic used for onboarding and login page hero graphics.
